physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the stomach, the soft hollow under the ribs where what you take in is turned, slowly, into what you can use. Food, drink, hour, conversation. Everything has to pass through this room and be sorted before any of it becomes you. When the sorting goes well, energy arrives. When it does not, you run on borrowed reserves and call it stamina.

The shadow has its bodily floor here. Exhaustion is not vague. It lives in the stomach first. Acid where there should be ease. A tight knot before meals you did not want. The slow grinding of a body trying to break down a life that does not agree with it. The wear backs up through the kidneys and the small of the back, where the adrenals quietly empty themselves keeping a forced life upright. The tiredness sleep cannot reach starts here, under your hand if you lay it flat below your ribs.

The climb out is also bodily, and quieter than people expect. Hunger comes back as something honest. Meals slow down. The belly softens at the end of a day instead of bracing for the next one. Resolve is not a clenched jaw. It is a stomach that has stopped fighting what is being put into it, because what is being put into it has, finally, started to be yours.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Glycine. The smallest of them, the simplest, the one the body uses when it needs to quiet a nerve down. Glycine is one of the signals the nervous system reaches for when it wants the body to let go: it slows the messages, drops the tension a notch, lets the muscle release.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the quiet centre of this card. The code whose shadow is exhaustion runs on the chemistry of release. The way out was never going to be more force. It was going to be a substance the body already knows how to make for itself, used to tell its own cells to stand down.

This is why the card keeps returning, in different voices, to the same instruction. Stop pushing. The chemistry says it lower than any teaching. The code runs all the way to this: a will that finds its full strength only by learning, at the cellular level, how to let go.
